title: Cross-tenant calendar sharing via XTAP slips to 4 December
summary: Microsoft updated MC1446796 on 23 November 2026: worldwide Calendar Sharing through Microsoft 365 Cross-Tenant Access Policy (XTAP) is now expected to complete by 4 December 2026, previously 23 November. The GCC, GCC High and DoD rollout remains paused. Free/Busy and MailTips via XTAP were already due by 15 September. The EWSEnabled extension still keeps EWS-based sharing alive until the final EWS shutdown on 1 April 2027.
why: This is the second slip for the one piece of the EWS replacement that most partner-heavy tenants need. Anyone who planned to remove Sharing Policies this week has nothing to migrate to yet.
todo: Do not remove EWS-based Sharing Policies until XTAP calendar sharing is visible in your tenant.
Keep EWSEnabled set for the tenant if partners still rely on shared calendars; the bridge ends 1 April 2027.
effective_note: Worldwide completion date per the 23 November 2026 update of MC1446796; Gov clouds paused.
